library(tidyverse)
setwd ("/Users/cmdb/qb25-answers/week_1/")

header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
dfA <- read_tsv( "hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )
dfB <- read_tsv( "hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

df_19_16 <- bind_rows( hg19=dfA, hg16=dfB, .id="assembly" )

ggplot(data = df_19_16, aes(x=start, y=count, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Start" , 
    y = "Count" , 
    title = "Gene density across main chromosomes in hg19 and hg16"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ chr, scales = "free")
